caption:
how much sunscreen should you put on your face?

SPF is measured with a thick layer — 2 mg per cm². In a small study (26 people, company-funded), a normal application on the face came out at about half that.

Easy check: squeeze your usual amount onto your fingertips, then double it.

At Danish beaches, a second coat nearly doubled the amount people actually had on (0.57 → 1.10 mg/cm²) — still below the test amount, but much closer.

Same bottle. Just more of it.

General education only.
